decisions.reason: Showing the book cover in full does not change the hero text, CTA, or messaging style.
The book-cover display adjustment does not change any FAQ content.
The candidate already records the separate same-message change to the How It Works label; the book-cover clause does not alter mechanics messaging.
Refitting the independently placed landing-page cover to show it in full does not necessarily change the hero layout, sizing, or overlap constraints.
The cover-fit adjustment does not affect dashboard commission or ticket accounting displays.
The landing-page cover image is distinct from the PDF.js ebook reading and download experience.
The visual treatment of the book cover has no effect on prize eligibility, randomness, or winner selection.
The cover display adjustment does not change the mint number, referral-code persistence, or referral-code display locations.
The landing-page book-cover fit does not affect automatic prize transfer or winner notifications.
The source changes a landing-page image presentation, not NFT metadata fields or visibility.
The cover-fit adjustment does not change rewards for mints made without referral codes.
The landing-page cover display does not change prize-pool allocations, funding sources, or active pools.
